source: re/buu/notes.md 'Field: triggers, breakables, pickups, game state'; tools/field/rec_objects.py; re/buu/obj_gd.py (dump)

game_data.new_game: 0x080042FC: memset(GD, 0, 0x8A8), then the 9 character records from 0x086FDA4C (0x12 bytes each) via 0x0801339C

fields.name: current_character
fields.notes: index of the active character record (0..8); the player object's record = GD+0x4F8+0x68*this

fields.name: game_bits
fields.notes: bit1 set in every save seen (meaning unknown); bit2 countdown running (natives 0xAE/0xAF); bit4 stopwatch running (0xBF/0xC0); bit5 game_bit_20 (0xC4/0xC5): while set, the per-frame tick 0x0800425C tests the player's footprint on the walk grid (0x08009324) and when it is NOT walkable clears bit5 and runs event 0x0877CCDC (the race's off-course check); bit6 game_bit_40 (0xEB)

fields.name: supplies
fields.notes: count of supply item i at GD+2+i (items 0..24 consumables, 25..82 story items: supply def 0x083BD2F8+0x34*i byte0 bit0); add saturates at 255 (0x0801E164, native 0x81)

fields.name: story_flags
fields.notes: flag f = bit (f & 7) of GD+0x55+(f >> 3) (0x08004364 test, 0x08004380 set, 0x08004396 clear); region ends where the equipment count starts (+0xE4), so f < 1144 (INFERRED bound); GD+0x8D.. (flags 448..) are the map-visited bits per the transitions fork

fields.name: equipment_count
fields.notes: number of owned equipment entries

fields.name: equipment_list
fields.notes: entry = item id (low 28 bits) | equipped marker (high 4 bits, nonzero = equipped; take_equipment 0x08004468 only removes entries with high nibble 0); append 0x08004448 (no-op when count == 250, i.e. a full list silently drops the item), remove = memmove; count of copies = 0x0800441E

fields.name: play_time_base
fields.notes: play time in frames = [0x03000F94] (logic frame counter, not advanced on lag frames) + this; 0x0800432C (base -= counter) converts a loaded total into the base

fields.name: countdown
fields.notes: while game_bits bit2: -1 per field frame (0x0800425C); at 0: bit2 cleared and event 0x0877CD58 runs

fields.name: stopwatch
fields.notes: while game_bits bit4: +1 per field frame; reaching 0x8CA0 (36000 = 10 min) clears bit4 and runs event 0x0877CD88

fields.name: holy_water
fields.notes: +0x4DC frames left (-1 per field frame; at 0 the player's stats are recalculated 0x0801064C); +0x4E0..+0x4EC bonuses STR/POW/END/SPD

fields.name: timed_special
fields.notes: copied to record +0x67 (player hittable flag +0x1CC = (value == 0)); native 0xF7

fields.name: zenie
fields.notes: coin pickup adds the coin value (5/25/50/100), no cap

fields.name: character_records
fields.notes: record i = character i (0 Goku .. 7 Gogeta, 8 = forms 46..53; data/buu/characters.json record_layout). byte0: bit0 in party (natives 0x96..0x98; party size 0x0800433E counts bit0 of records 0..7), bit1 set_char_flag2 (meaning unknown, set for all in the saves seen); +0x0C known-skill count, +0x0D.. skill ids, +0x2E+2i/+0x2F+2i skill level pair, +0x14 current form, +0x16..+0x20 HP/maxHP/EP/maxEP/SS gauges, +0x24 XP, +0x28..+0x2B base stats, +0x2C stat points, +0x3C..+0x48 equipped item ids (body, hands, feet, accessory); forms unlocked are not stored (scripts gate them)

fields.name: tail
fields.notes: zero in every state seen

fields.name: script_globals_G
fields.notes: G0..G3 (shared by nested scripts); not in GameData

fields.name: script_words_L
fields.notes: get_l0..get_l3 (natives 0x08..0x0B)

fields.name: loot_pos
fields.notes: drop position (px) set by the dying enemy / breaking breakable

fields.name: loot_vel
fields.notes: drop scatter base velocity; breakable: direction vector of the hit (table 0x0807268C) << 8

fields.name: variant_byte
fields.notes: native 0x11 / setter 17

fields.name: area_state
fields.notes: +0 u8 world, +1 u8 area, +2 u8 variant (1-based as objects.json), +4 area record ptr (0x0808E2E0 + 0x38*i), +0xC area flag (native 0xDB), +0x10 area-load counter

fields.name: trigger_list
fields.notes: +0 count, +4.. trigger ptrs (checked last to first); +0xC4 check counter (+1 per check pass), +0xC8 generation (changes when the list is rebuilt: touch_once keeps its trigger if it changed during the activation), +0xCC 'checking' flag, +0xD0 enabled (0 = no trigger checks)

fields.name: frame_counter
fields.notes: logic frame counter
